record_title: Exact power-avoiding factorization for finite nilpotent groups
provenance: Exact factorization of the power-avoiding independence number for finite nilpotent groups, with an explicit order-spectrum term and a closed cyclic formula for prime power maps.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Functional-graph structure is prior art. The full texts of Fernandes-Reis (Discrete Mathematics 347 (2024), 114000) and McVeagh's 2026 thesis were not independently inspected and remain the principal prior-art risks. For a general nonabelian primary factor the rooted-tree statistic is not evaluated in closed group-theoretic form. No independent validation is asserted.
